title: A Calm Start to an International Trip
passage: Mina checked her itinerary before leaving for the airport. Her luggage was light, and her passport was in a safe pocket. At the departure hall, an employee helped her confirm the destination and boarding time.

questions.prompt: Mina checked her _____ before leaving, so she knew the plan for her trip.
choiceExplanations: 行程表列出旅行計畫，對應 knew the plan。
員工指人，不是旅行計畫。
行李是攜帶的物品，不是行程安排。
目的地只指出要去哪裡，不代表整份旅行計畫。
questions.evidence: Mina checked her itinerary before leaving for the airport.
questions.explanation: 行程表列出旅行計畫，對應 knew the plan。

questions.prompt: Her _____ was light enough to carry easily.
choiceExplanations: 出發是事件，這裡描述能攜帶的物品。
原文指出行李很輕，因此可輕鬆攜帶。
護照也可攜帶，但原文說 light 的是 luggage。
機場是地點，不能攜帶。
questions.evidence: Her luggage was light, and her passport was in a safe pocket.
questions.explanation: 原文指出行李很輕，因此可輕鬆攜帶。

questions.prompt: An employee _____ Mina confirm the boarding time.
choiceExplanations: 過去事件需使用過去式；主詞 employee 為單數也不搭配現在式 help。
敘事使用過去式，且 help someone do something 可接原形 confirm。
沒有助動詞，helping 不能單獨充當這句的限定動詞。
helps to 後面不能直接接 Mina confirm；此處也需要過去式。
questions.evidence: At the departure hall, an employee helped her confirm the destination and boarding time.
questions.explanation: 敘事使用過去式，且 help someone do something 可接原形 confirm。

title: Responsibility at a Busy Office
passage: When a new employee joins the office, Leo looks after the training schedule and takes care of practical questions. A good manager listens to feedback and gives people support.

questions.prompt: Leo _____ the training schedule for each new employee.
choiceExplanations: 照料訓練安排，對應原文 looks after。
不是找不到時程而去尋找。
只是看著，沒有表達負責管理。
調查通常是探究問題，原文不是調查訓練時程。
questions.evidence: When a new employee joins the office, Leo looks after the training schedule and takes care of practical questions.
questions.explanation: 照料訓練安排，對應原文 looks after。

questions.prompt: Leo _____ practical questions from the new team member.
choiceExplanations: 此處是處理新同事的實際問題。
脫下或起飛不符合處理問題的意思。
表示與家人相似，不能表達處理問題。
接管工作或職務，不是本文使用的處理問題搭配。
questions.evidence: When a new employee joins the office, Leo looks after the training schedule and takes care of practical questions.
questions.explanation: 此處是處理新同事的實際問題。

questions.prompt: A good manager listens to _____ from the team.
choiceExplanations: 主管聆聽團隊的回饋意見。
出發不是此處聆聽的內容。
行李是物品，不是意見。
passenger 指乘客；本文談的是團隊回饋，並非乘客。
questions.evidence: A good manager listens to feedback and gives people support.
questions.explanation: 主管聆聽團隊的回饋意見。
